measurements.nso_homepage_2026_10_20: https://www.nso.gov.vn/en/ -> HTTP 200 (redirected to /en/homepage/), 107,925 bytes, Avada WordPress theme - a publication/listing site, not a data API. /en/statistics-data/ -> HTTP 404. A repeat homepage probe minutes later: local DNS failure (curl exit 6) though public DoH still resolves nso.gov.vn -> 160.25.148.3 - .vn resolution from the coordinator is intermittent.

rejection_reason: Parked as a PDF/publication-only publisher per the standing rule: the current publisher channel is a publication archive with no machine-readable API and no event-level data found; the 2018 national open-data portal data.gov.vn is dark in DNS (no A record at apex or www). Compounding it, .vn name resolution from this coordinator is unreliable (same hosts resolving then failing within minutes, measured). This is an access/infrastructure park, not a data judgement - nothing about the publisher's data quality was evaluated.
next_action: Unpark path: (1) identify the current machine-readable channel, if any - probe from a worker for Vietnamese-language data sections (XLSX monthly releases), and watch for a relaunch of data.gov.vn or a new VNNIC open-data host; (2) re-probe quarterly. If a machine-readable channel appears, re-evaluate from scratch - the bench would still need a task family absent from it. Until then this source yields nothing.
